name: text-scale-y-unfold
title: Vertical Unfold
description: Từng ký tự mở ra từ mép trên xuống như tấm rèm, nảy nhẹ khi đủ chiều cao.

moworks.author: moworks

options.accent: the bar that marks a folded letter
options.outAt: s they fold back (2.3, 0.35 s ease-in cubic)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here
credit.upstream: after Codrops (MIT); a faithful port of Codrops' effects is in the Codrops collection

moworks.notes: Split chars, pivot 50 % 0 % (top). Each char scaleY 0 → 1 over 0.6 s back.out(1.7) (cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)), stagger 30 ms (demo 70 ms capped 0.6 s total) from 0.3 s, like blinds dropping from the top line; a thin accent bar marks a still-folded char. Loop exit: chars fold back to scaleY 0, 0.35 s inCubic, stagger 0.6× the in stagger, from 2.3 s; loop 3 s. Params: duration (0.6 s) · stagger (0.03 s) · origin: mép trên · ease (back.out(1.7)).
moworks.titleVi: Ký tự mở ra từ mép trên
